name: Glass Settings Screen
description: An iOS-grade settings screen for a journaling app: a large title that folds into a glass nav bar, springy switches, a gliding segmented control and a size slider.

props.name: profile
props.description: Name, email, plan, renewal, entries, streak and word count.

props.name: initial
props.description: Starting paper, text size, reminder, time, prompts, Face ID and sync values.

props.name: reminderTimes
props.description: Four reminder times shown when the row expands.

props.name: sample
props.description: Journal excerpt shown in the reading preview.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the full state after any change.

props.name: onDeleteAll
props.description: Fired when deletion is confirmed in the sheet.
